patterns.title: Mockito NotAMockException
patterns.summary: The test is trying to stub or verify a real object instead of an allowed Mockito mock.
containsAny: argument passed to when() is not a mock
patterns.llmHeuristic: Never stub constructor-local real objects. Move stubbing and verification to collaborators from shouldMock.

patterns.title: Mockito NullInsteadOfMockException
patterns.summary: The test tries to verify or stub a collaborator reference that is null because the declared mock was never opened or never injected into the class under test.
containsAny: argument passed to verify() should be a mock but is null
argument passed to when() should be a mock but is null
patterns.llmHeuristic: Open or initialize the declared mock and inject that same mock instance into the class under test; do not keep a second unused real collaborator alongside the mock.

patterns.title: Mockito MissingMethodInvocationException
patterns.summary: The stubbing expression is malformed or points at something Mockito cannot intercept.
patterns.llmHeuristic: Patch only the invalid stubbing expression. Ensure the call inside when(...) is a real mock invocation.

patterns.title: Verification target not invoked
patterns.summary: The test is verifying the wrong collaborator, wrong branch, or wrong arguments for the real control flow.
patterns.llmHeuristic: Preserve the compilable test and align verification with actual collaborator calls or branch conditions from source.

patterns.title: Verification arguments differ
patterns.summary: The collaborator is invoked, but the literal, prefix, or matcher in the test does not match the real runtime payload.
patterns.llmHeuristic: Prefer source-derived prefixes and deterministic recipes over hand-written literal guesses.

patterns.title: Computed source payload verified with guessed exact literal
patterns.summary: The generated test verifies an exact collaborator string that includes a source-computed value, such as a normalized score, so sibling tests fail when the real computed suffix differs from the guessed literal.
patterns.llmHeuristic: When the source builds a collaborator string as a literal prefix plus computed expression, use the provided deterministic recipe to align verifications to startsWith(sourcePrefix) instead of guessing the computed suffix.

patterns.title: NullPointerException in generated test path
patterns.summary: A collaborator, fixture, or constructor path was left uninitialized for the exercised branch.
patterns.llmHeuristic: Initialize only the missing collaborator or branch dependency. Do not regenerate the full test.

patterns.title: Current-time assertion window too narrow
patterns.summary: The generated test asserts a value derived from Instant.now() against a timestamp captured outside the act window, making the runtime assertion unstable.
containsAny: time did not match the expected value
patterns.llmHeuristic: For source code that assigns Instant.now() during the act phase, assert the observed timestamp is between Instant values captured immediately before and after the target call.

patterns.title: Rebound threshold attempts too low
patterns.summary: The generated test expects the high-rebound branch but under-drives the public login-attempt state, so reboundFactor stays at or below the real threshold.
patterns.llmHeuristic: When source branches on LegacyScoreRules.reboundFactor(user.getLoginAttempts(), user.isActive()), prefer the deterministic recipe that raises login attempts through public incrementAttempts() calls before the act phase.

patterns.title: Assertion or comparison failure
patterns.summary: The test executes, but the asserted value or side effect does not match the real behavior.
patterns.llmHeuristic: Keep setup stable and patch only the assertion or the immediately related branch-driving stub; when a deterministic threshold/rejection recipe is present, prefer it over changing only the assertion.

patterns.title: Threshold branch input too high
patterns.summary: The generated test expects a low-score rejection branch but uses a numeric act argument that crosses the real promotion threshold.
patterns.llmHeuristic: Do not flip only the assertion when rejection side effects are expected. Lower the concrete numeric branch input through the supplied deterministic recipe and keep rejection verifications aligned with source prefixes.

patterns.title: Mockito unnecessary stubbing
patterns.summary: The test contains stubs that are never consumed by the exercised path.
patterns.llmHeuristic: Delete or narrow unused stubs. Do not add lenient() unless the source path truly requires a flexible fixture.

patterns.title: Inherited static void blocker
patterns.summary: The tested method reaches a parent/helper method that invokes a static void side effect which throws unless the test scopes a static mock around the call.
patterns.llmHeuristic: If the parent/helper path calls a throwing static void, patch the generated test to use scoped Mockito.mockStatic around the act phase and keep the rest of the setup stable.
